categories.main_business_segments: SERAKU operates three main business segments: Digital Integration (DI), which includes IT infrastructure, cloud, DX, and cybersecurity services; the Midori Cloud segment, which provides IoT and digital transformation solutions for agriculture, livestock, and fisheries; and Mechanical Design Engineering, offering 3DCAD, mechanical design, and technical staffing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages expertise in IT infrastructure (network/server design, virtualization), cloud integration, IoT sensor platforms, AI/data science, and RPA. It emphasizes proprietary training programs to rapidly upskill IT talent and applies advanced security and quality management standards (ISO27001, ISO9001).
categories.primary_customers_markets: SERAKU primarily serves large enterprises, mid-sized companies, and public sector clients across industries such as IT, manufacturing, agriculture, and distribution. In the Midori Cloud segment, the main customers are agricultural producers, livestock operators, and related cooperatives (e.g., JA).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Japan, with offices and service centers nationwide (Tokyo, Sapporo, Osaka, Fukuoka, Nagoya, Yokohama, etc.), and a small overseas presence in China (Shenyang). Over 90% of revenue is from domestic Japanese customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: SERAKU is positioned as a downstream IT service provider and systems integrator, delivering end-to-end solutions directly to end-users and enterprise clients. In agriculture, it acts as a digital enabler for producers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding digital transformation (DX) and AI-driven services, developing proprietary platforms (e.g., Midori Cloud, NewtonX), and strengthening talent development. R&D focuses on AI, IoT, and new digital solutions for both enterprise and primary industries, with ongoing investment in new business models and service innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based solution services (fixed-price or time-based contracts), on-site technical staffing, recurring cloud service fees, hardware sales (IoT devices), and support/maintenance contracts. There is also a growing component of SaaS and platform subscription revenue in the Midori Cloud segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major Japanese SIers (e.g., NTT Data, Fujitsu, NEC), IT staffing firms, and specialized DX/IoT solution providers. SERAKU differentiates itself through its proprietary IT talent development model and focus on both enterprise DX and primary industry digitalization, positioning itself as a mid-sized, agile digital integrator.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, consolidated revenue reached approximately 24.8 billion yen (up 11.5% YoY), with operating profit of 2.55 billion yen and net profit of 1.71 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady double-digit revenue and profit growth over the past several years, with a workforce of over 3,200 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SERAKU emphasizes its unique education-driven talent creation model, enabling rapid deployment of skilled IT engineers and flexible scaling for client projects. Its proprietary platforms (Midori Cloud, NewtonX) and integrated DX/IoT solutions offer clients both operational efficiency and digital innovation, while its deep sector expertise in both enterprise IT and agriculture provides a competitive edge.
